messages:
marta: Quick accessibility catch: with VoiceOver the invoke panel focus jumps to the close button before the first parameter. Repro on macOS Safari.
ryan: thanks. that sounds like DOM order vs visual order. can you share steps?
marta: repro steps: open playground -> pick function -> click 'Invoke' -> VO+RightArrow. focus lands on close.
samir: likely the close btn appears earlier in DOM due to layout. quick fixes: tabindex=-1 on close and programmatic focus to first input, or reorder DOM and use CSS to position.
olivia: copy/friction: the UI uses both "Run" and "Invoke" labels. let's standardize to "Invoke" in the playground so screen reader users aren't confused.
ryan: agree. visible label should match accessible name. avoid tooltip-only explanations.
marta: also low-contrast badges in run history on dark theme; token tweak needed. propose #245a9a for better AA.
samir: i'll update theming tokens and add a sr-only span for variant names in run summaries (so SR users hear "variant: X" without expanding).
olivia: add an aria-live toast for copy action ("Copied parameters to prompt") so screen readers get feedback.
ryan: can we add a tiny VoiceOver smoke test to CI? open panel -> focus first param -> toggle -> confirm history entry.
marta: willing to validate on mac once PR is up.
devex-bot: created DEVEX-3001 "Invoke panel: VO focus order + label standardization + contrast" -> https://issues.redwood/DEVEX-3001 :white_check_mark:
ryan: plan: keep changes minimal (aria attrs + copy + token tweak). aim for patch release this week.
samir: i'll send a small PR with aria updates and a short screencast.
olivia: i'll update copy strings in i18n keys and post diffs.
marta: awesome, thanks team :thumbsup:
